title: An injective C¹ immersion is anti-Lipschitz on compact sets (supplied step 4(b), "Bi-Lipschitz chart")
statement: Let P, N ∈ ℕ, ψ : ℝ^N → ℝ^P be C¹ (ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ) and C ⊆ ℝ^N compact. Suppose ψ is injective on C and Dψ(y) = fderiv ℝ ψ y is injective for every y ∈ C. Then there is c > 0 with c|a − b| ≤ |ψ(a) − ψ(b)| for all a, b ∈ C.
lean_statement: ∀ (P N : ℕ) (ψ : Euclid N → Euclid P) (C : Set (Euclid N)), ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → IsCompact C → InjOn ψ C → (∀ y ∈ C, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ y)) → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ a ∈ C, ∀ b ∈ C, c * ‖a - b‖ ≤ ‖ψ a - ψ b‖
